g.data-poe: PoE/PoE+ (to 30 W per port by PSE)
g.data-description: the twelve ReadyLink coax ports, RL1 to RL12 as the card prints them. Every port does PoE and PoE+; ports 11 and 12 also do PoE++ (the datasheet's note - "Ports 11 and 12 of each line card are PoE++ ports").
